about: Wording the stale-syllabus gate (data/cia/tools/check_stale_terms.py) refuses in learner-readable CIA text. Each term carries the evidence that it is not the 2024 vocabulary: counts are case-insensitive counts in the text of the opened files (Global Internal Audit Standards published 9 January 2024; the four syllabus files V2.09.2024 FINAL and V2.10.2025 FINAL; The IIA's two-way mapping of the 2017 IPPF to the 2024 Standards), made 2026-11-19. A term may not be added without evidence. 'IPPF' alone is NOT banned: the 2024 Standards still describe the International Professional Practices Framework (Standards, Topical Requirements, Global Guidance).

classes.2019: Vocabulary of the 2017 Standards and the 2019 syllabus. Never in learner text, except where an allow entry marks a place that teaches 'old term, new term'.
classes.house: A current synonym KaiSip does not use, so learners meet one term.
classes.isaca: ISACA role and authority terms. Never in the three Part packs; allowed only in the Challenge pack's CISA bridge.
